import pathlib, collections
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [c for c in counts if c != bg]
    # Markers are foreground cells isolated from all other foreground cells.
    isolated = {}
    for c in colors:
        pts=[]
        for r in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                if grid[r][x] != c:
                    continue
                if all(not (0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= x+dc < w) or grid[r+dr][x+dc] == bg
                       for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1) if (dr,dc)!=(0,0)):
                    pts.append((r,x))
        isolated[c]=pts
    marker = max(colors, key=lambda c: len(isolated[c]))
    targets = isolated[marker]
    source = [(r,x,grid[r][x]) for r in range(h) for x in range(w)
              if grid[r][x] != bg and grid[r][x] != marker]
    rmin=min(r for r,x,v in source); rmax=max(r for r,x,v in source)
    cmin=min(x for r,x,v in source); cmax=max(x for r,x,v in source)
    ar=(rmin+rmax)//2; ac=(cmin+cmax)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for tr,tc in targets:
        dr,dc=tr-ar,tc-ac
        for r,x,v in source:
            rr,xx=r+dr,x+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                out[rr][xx]=v
    return out
'''
path=base/'programs'/'task-905d47ef.py'; path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); path.write_text('import collections\n\n'+prog)
print(path)
